title: Why do we have bones?
examples: Why are bones important for our bodies?
What do our bones help us do?
Do bones just keep us standing up?

explain.say: Our bones help to hold us up so we can stand tall.
They also keep our soft parts safe inside our bodies.
Bones help us move our arms and our legs around.

draw.text: Bones help us move our body.

explain.say: When you run and play, your bones help you move your body.

draw.text: Running uses your bones to move.

explain.say: Sometimes we forget that bones help us keep our insides safe.
A common mistake is thinking bones are just hard sticks.

items: Bones are strong but also flexible.
They work with muscles to move.
They are living parts of you.

draw.text: Bones are not just hard sticks.

faq.q: Why do we need bones at all?
faq.a: We need bones because they give our body its shape and support everything.
asks: What is the job of my skeleton?
Are bones just for looking strong?

faq.a: No, bones do not help us breathe, but they protect the parts that do.
asks: Do ribs help me take a breath?

faq.a: No, we cannot move without bones because they act like strong frames.
asks: What happens if I lose my bones?
Do I need bones to walk?

faq.q: Are bones always the same color?
faq.a: No, bones can look different colors depending on how old they are.
The strong bones of your skull protect your soft brain inside your head.
asks: Does my head have bones for protection?

facts: Bones give the body its shape and structure.
The rib cage protects the heart and lungs.
Bones work with muscles to allow movement.
The skeleton is made up of many different bones.

quiz.say: What is one main job of bones?
quiz.why: Bones act like a frame to keep you standing up tall.

wrong.0: Breathing is done by muscles, not bones.
wrong.1: Eating is done by your mouth and stomach.
wrong.2: Seeing is done by your eyes.

quiz.say: If you hit your arm, which bones help keep your elbow safe?
quiz.why: The bones in your arm protect the soft parts inside.

wrong.1: Skin is outside and does not protect the elbow bones.
wrong.2: Muscle helps move, but bones provide the hard protection.
wrong.3: Blood flows through, but it does not form the protective structure.

quiz.say: Which action shows bones helping you move?
quiz.why: Kicking uses strong bones in your leg to push the ball.

wrong.0: Listening uses your ears, not your leg bones.
wrong.1: Thinking happens in your brain, not with your legs.
wrong.3: Sleeping is resting, not actively moving.
